The tasting we had sealed the deal for us. The manager Brandi was super sweet to us and everything we tasted was delicious!

For appetizers we chose the fruit display with chocolate mousse, chips and guac, and the absolute crowd favorite of mac and cheese with assorted toppings.

For dinner we chose the dinner buffet serving the Cabernet beef, garlic cream chicken, green bean casserole, garlic mashed potatoes, and a field greens salad with rolls. They also accommodated a few vegan guests with a stuffed portobello mushroom with potatoes and vegetables.

Let me tell you, do not pass on that mac and cheese! Every person that commented on the food mentioned it. It’s delicious and kids and adults love it!

The chicken and the beef are both covered in sauce so they are flavorful and not dry at all. I heard several compliments on those dishes as well. A few parents told me their kids actually ate real food because everything was so good. This is great considering we didn’t necessarily pick foods with children in mind, but the choices were well received!

We also selected sweet and unsweet tea, water and lemonade, plus coffee. The coffee was a big hit as well! Never underestimate how tired your guests will get. They’ll dance exhausted but keep chugging the coffee!

Brandi was very easy to work with and never dropped the ball on communication. She responded promptly and always has an out of office message when she isn’t available.

The service staff did their job without getting in the way, blending in and cleaning up promptly.

As far as I’m aware we had plenty of food and did not run out of anything before everyone was served. The food was a good temperature and the flavor was consistent with the tasting we had.

There were boxes of leftovers packed up for us, including cake (which we opted in for the cake cutting services).

We found this vendor through the venue as they were a preferred vendor. It’s definitely a plus to know that your caterer knows the venue, their rules, and the layout. I did not hear of any problems from the coordinator with the catering team, so if anything went wrong it never affected our experience.

I’d gladly recommend Courtney’s Catering to anyone looking for a full service I had interviewed several other planners/events companies prior to deciding on Wedding Day Girl, and I must say, I was immediately impressed with the level of expertise and true dedication to their craft that I experienced when speaking with Amina and Kylie. It’s never great to write a not-stellar review for a vendor, but I would not recommend Lily Grace catering unless you are choosing something simple that they work with all of the time (BBQ, pizza, etc). We chose Lily grace as our caterer for our 2023 wedding, and our main complaint was that communication felt disjointed throughout the whole process. I know their team does a lot of weddings, however, it felt like there were a lot of times where we had to remind their team about our selections for things. Their team took incredibly long to respond to our emails, and took a while to communicate our selections and solidify our menu choices with the restaurant that we selected to have our food from and we felt a lot of extra stress having to remind/ask their team if our order with the restaurant was actually placed and solidified yet. Our menu for our wedding ended up not being solidified until the end of the month just before, which of course, made us super nervous and did not seem normal. We actually did not even know what our final payment was until 4 weeks before, which was a bit nervewracking. The restaurant that we partnered with even commented to us multiple times that catering orders for weddings are typically placed 3-4 months in advance, and was shocked that Lily Grace’s team solidified things with them only one month in advance. The restaurant manager called my husband and I directly multiple times to ask if we were still planning on catering with them since she hadn’t heard anything from Lily Grace’s team until late in the process. Last but not least - we were really dissatisfied with our cake cutting service. Quite a bit of our guests were refused cake due to it being frozen (I do not believe that this was a fault of their team). However, during the wedding, my husband asked if he could have a slice of cake for us to share, and he was told “No, sorry, but we did pack some for you already to take home!” What on earth?! Being refused a slice of cake at our own wedding was a bit odd. He felt very weird about that. Once we finally did get home, we realized that Lily Grace’s team packed us TWO ENTIRE tiers of cake to take home. We were incredibly confused and realized this was likely the reasoning behind some of our guests not being able to get any cake - because we had two entire tiers of it packed for us, which we definitely did not want or need. We communicated multiple times that we only wanted the small top tier saved for our one year anniversary. So many of our guests didn’t get any cake and the their that they sent us home with could have easily fed 30-40 more people. This is just a warning to prospective couples that if you choose them, you will need to really stay on top of communication with them and might end up needing to do way more communication than you expect.

POSITIVES: On a positive note, their bar service got a lot of compliments! They were super speedy and amazing on that front. The drinks were delicious and strong and we were able to create our own signature drinks which everyone loved. They also provided our linens and tableware which looked great and was exactly what we wanted. Their getaway car service was also awesome. They were also one of our lowest catering quotes.
